name: CSO_SEARCH_STATS
description: This table will be populated hourly and daily from cso_stg_questions. Hourly rollup will be deleted at the end of every day once the day ends. At the end of every month, older daily rollup data will be purged.

columns.name: SEARCH_STATS_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Populated by sequence number.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STAT_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the stats occurred.

columns.name: STAT_HOUR
columns.description: Applicable for window=1 and represents the HOUR of the DAY for which the data belongs to.

columns.name: NORMALIZED_QUESTION_ID
columns.description: The unique ID used to track the text for a given normalized question.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the locale in CSO_LOCALE table.

columns.name: QUESTION_COUNT
columns.description: The question count is the number of questions asked. These questions can be actual or normalized questions.

columns.name: RESPONSE_COUNT
columns.description: The response count is the number of responses returned for a given question. The question can be an actual or normalized question.

columns.name: WINDOW
columns.description: 1-hourly, 2-daily, 3-monthly (rollup strategy).

columns.name: UNKNOWN_WORD_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unknown words that are not configured in search application.

columns.name: CONCEPT_MATCH_COUNT
columns.description: Number of known words or concepts that are configured in search application.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the department as stored by knowledge and will be used for striping questions.
